verses.english: The Chapter on Ways of Performing Deeds

verses.pali: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti, parañca pāṇātipāte samādapeti, pāṇātipāte ca samanuñño hoti.
verses.english: They themselves kill living creatures. They encourage others to kill living creatures. And they approve of killing living creatures.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: Someone with these three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
